requirements.basis: The closed post-approval block enumerates the external run manifest, evaluator configuration, provider profile and settings, provider-relay contract, immutable pricing, spend authorization, calibration-launch authorization, and every owning schema or contract.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-plan, paragraph beginning 'After exact approval'

requirements.basis: After approval and immediately before durable run consumption, the supervisor no-follow opens and captures each named regular file, recomputes its hash, validates every owning schema or contract, and revalidates identities, scope, cross-field equality, principal, ceiling, and time.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-plan, paragraphs beginning 'After exact approval' and 'The captured byte population'

requirements.basis: The effective command, configuration, relay binding, and every other launch input are derived exclusively from the captured bytes in the same process; path reopen and separately parsed substitution are forbidden.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-plan, paragraph beginning 'The captured byte population'

requirements.basis: The design refuses before marker or container creation on path re-read, missing or non-regular input, byte drift, identity, scope, or time mismatch, expiry, insufficient remaining interval, or inability to construct launch solely from the snapshot.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-plan, paragraph beginning 'The captured byte population'

requirements.basis: The exact phase order places complete snapshot capture, revalidation, and binding before marker creation, and the start marker binds the complete prerequisite-snapshot digest.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-stop, evaluator phase order and following start-marker paragraph

checks.basis: Revision 4 defines one complete, immutable, launch-consumed snapshot across the full prerequisite population, binds its digest before container creation, and fail-closes every listed drift or binding failure.

requirements.basis: The stopped container must have Docker logging type exactly none with an empty options map, and the supervisor verifies the host-visible effective configuration before start.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-isolate, paragraph beginning 'The container entrypoint'

requirements.basis: The frozen trusted wrapper is prohibited from emitting any byte to inherited standard output or standard error before descriptor rebinding.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-isolate, paragraph beginning 'The supervisor then starts'

requirements.basis: The wrapper first opens create-once, no-follow, mode-0600 regular files on the /run/out mount, replaces descriptors 1 and 2, closes originals, and later execs the evaluator without changing those descriptors.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-isolate, paragraphs beginning 'The supervisor then starts' and 'Only after descriptor binding succeeds'

requirements.basis: Both /proc/self/fd targets must resolve canonically inside /run/out, and the durable boundary receipt includes their targets and the host-verified logging configuration before evaluator exec.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-isolate, descriptor-binding and boundary-receipt paragraphs

requirements.basis: Any open, type, mount, replacement, resolution, effective-config, probe, or receipt failure prevents evaluator execution; because the wrapper runs after the create-once marker, the failure permanently fails that run identity.
requirements.ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md, Decision C5C-isolate; Decision C5C-stop, start-marker failure paragraph; obligations C5M-2 and C5M-6

checks.basis: Revision 4 disables Docker logging, silently rebinds both output descriptors into the encrypted result mount before evaluator execution, proves and records the effective targets, and fail-closes any deviation.
